metadata.disclaimer: Verify eligibility and deadlines on each official provider site before applying. KursoKo does not process applications.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Entries include verificationDate and verificationSource from official government or foundation pages only.

scholarships.name: Free Higher Education (FHE)
eligibility: Filipino students in eligible public higher education institutions per RA 10931 implementing rules
benefits: Free tuition and other school fees at eligible SUCs and LUCs per official UniFAST program rules

scholarships.name: Tertiary Education Subsidy (TES)
eligibility: Students meeting TES criteria as published by UniFAST/CHED
benefits: Financial assistance for tertiary education under the TES program
coverage: Approved educational expenses per TES guidelines
requirements: Apply through official UniFAST TES process

scholarships.name: Free Tech-Voc Education and Training (FTVET)
eligibility: Learners in eligible technical-vocational programs per UniFAST rules
benefits: Free tech-voc education and training at eligible institutions
coverage: Tech-voc program fees per official guidelines

scholarships.name: Student Loan Program – Short Term (SLP)
eligibility: Students who meet SLP criteria published by UniFAST
benefits: Short-term student loan assistance for tertiary education
coverage: Loan amount and terms per official SLP guidelines

scholarships.name: DOST-SEI Undergraduate Scholarship
eligibility: STEM-oriented students meeting DOST-SEI published qualification standards
benefits: Scholarship support for priority science and technology courses (see DOST-SEI site for current benefits)
coverage: Tuition and allowances per DOST-SEI program guidelines

scholarships.name: CHED–UniFAST Programs Portal
eligibility: Varies by program — see individual FHE, TES, FTVET, and SLP pages
benefits: Central hub for Republic Act 10931 student financial assistance programs
requirements: Follow instructions on the official UniFAST website
